description: A comprehensive API verification script that tests various endpoints related to seeded data, user authentication, health checks, and emoji reactions for the sports live stream platform backend.

classes.name: APIVerifier
classes.description: Class responsible for performing API tests, logging results, and managing test state, including authentication and endpoint verification tasks.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str = "http://localhost:3001")
methods.description: Initializes the APIVerifier with default base URL, sets up authentication token and test results list.

methods.name: log_test(self, endpoint: str, status: str, message: str, data: Any = None)
methods.description: Logs individual test results including endpoint, status, message, timestamp, and data sample.

methods.name: test_health_check(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient)
methods.description: Performs a health check GET request to the root endpoint.

methods.name: test_users_endpoint(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient)
methods.description: Fetches user list and checks for UUID format in user identifiers.

methods.name: attempt_authentication(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient)
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate with admin credentials and updates authorization headers upon success.

methods.name: test_endpoint_with_auth(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, endpoint: str, method: str = "GET")
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request to a specified endpoint with optional method parameter.

methods.name: test_emoji_endpoints(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient)
methods.description: Tests emoji list and reaction endpoints, requires authentication.

methods.name: verify_all_endpoints(self)
methods.description: Runs a series of API tests covering health, user, match, highlight, schedule, profile, and emoji endpoints.

methods.name: print_summary(self)
methods.description: Outputs a summary count of test results and saves detailed results to a JSON file.

ctags.name: log_test
ctags.pattern: /^    def log_test(self, endpoint: str, status: str, message: str, data: Any = None):$/
ctags.signature: (self, endpoint: str, status: str, message: str, data: Any = None)

ctags.name: test_endpoint_with_auth
ctags.pattern: /^    async def test_endpoint_with_auth(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, endpoint: str, method: st/
ctags.signature: (self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, endpoint: str, method: str = "GET")
